Thanks for the context, Marissa - I reviewed the workbook and added a short list of clarifying items we'll need to close the questionnaire quickly. High level:

Key clarifications we typically need early:
- Systems in scope: confirm whether you want ETL/analytics (Redwood-hosted embedding index + downstream analytics) and any BI exports included. If you do, we'll need the data flow diagram.
- Auth: SSO provider (Okta/Azure AD), SCIM provisioning, and if you use delegated auth for API keys.
- KMS/HSM: if you require customer-managed keys, which KMS (AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault) and what account?
- Logging & retention: required log retention window and SIEM integration (Splunk/Datadog).
- PHI/PII: any regulated data classification that would affect scope (note: our hosted offering can be scoped to exclude PHI by design if required).

Marcus: can you prepare a short architecture note (1 page) that maps where embeddings are stored (S3/managed index), how KV cache is handled, and which components will be in-scope for the assessment? That will accelerate legal/procurement review.

I'll plan to lead the kickoff and own follow-ups for the SOC 2 / questionnaire items. If Medora agrees to include staging + prod and analytics, we should schedule a 60-min kickoff to run through the intake and capture procurement redlines.

-Neha
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
